definitions.explanation: The central character in a story, novel, film, game, or other narrative. Can also refer figuratively to the central person in a real-life situation.

examples.japanese: この{物語|ものがたり}の{主人公|しゅじんこう}は{少女|しょうじょ}だ。
examples.english: The protagonist of this story is a girl.

examples.japanese: {主人公|しゅじんこう}に{感情移入|かんじょういにゅう}してしまった。
examples.english: I ended up emotionally identifying with the main character.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}の{主人公|しゅじんこう}は{最後|さいご}に{大|おお}きな{決断|けつだん}をする。
examples.english: The protagonist of that film makes a big decision at the end.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主人公|しゅじんこう}を{演|えん}じる (to play the lead role)
- {物語|ものがたり}の{主人公|しゅじんこう} (the protagonist of a story)
- {主人公|しゅじんこう}に{感情移入|かんじょういにゅう}する (to identify with the main character)

USAGE: {主人公|しゅじんこう} is the standard literary and conversational term for the lead character of any narrative. It is used for novels, manga, anime, films, and games alike. In figurative use, {人生|じんせい}の{主人公|しゅじんこう} means "the protagonist of one's own life."
